text:
Challenger [VAR 0100(0000)].
We’ve been waiting for you.\c
Since you won your way through the Semifinals,
you must face off against the Gym Leaders in the
Finals. And they won’t be holding back.\c
Whoever makes it through this final bracket will
win the right to challenge the Champion...
So, are you ready to go to the locker room now?
Then I’ll show you the way.
Then let me know when you’re ready.
